item.title: Waterspouts spotted over Indian River Lagoon as severe weather strikes Sebastian and Port St. Lucie
item.description: Friday's severe weather left a trail of impacts across the Treasure Coast, with waterspouts, lightning strikes and fires reported from Sebastian to Port St. Lucie.

item.title: JetBlue ending Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9.

item.title: Martin County teacher challenges school board authority in termination appeal
item.description: A Martin County teacher is arguing the school board cannot reweigh evidence in her termination appeal.

item.title: St. Lucie County woman claims $5 million scratch-off jackpot from Fort Pierce store
item.description: Maria Duran, 57, of St. Lucie County turned a $20 scratch-off into a $5 million jackpot.

item.title: E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks prompt diet changes across Treasure Coast
item.description: Reports of contaminated produce continue to spread across the country, prompting many people in the Treasure Coast to change what they eat.

item.title: Florida Rep. Angie Nixon gets September trial date for Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Five cyclospora cases confirmed in Treasure Coast counties linked to national outbreak
item.description: Health officials confirmed two cases in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County since May as part of nationwide contamination concerns tied to lettuce and produce.

item.title: St. Lucie County woman claims $5 million lottery jackpot from Fort Pierce store
item.description: Maria Duran turned a $20 scratch-off ticket into a $5 million prize from a Fort Pierce convenience store earlier this year.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks 27-year-old mile world record in London
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 on Saturday in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's previous world record of 3:43.13 set in 1999.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 in World Cup semifinal, advances to final against Spain
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with two late goals to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals on Wednesday.

item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence decisions
item.description: MLB made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent the use of artificial intelligence for in-game decisions.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final in New Jersey on Sunday
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies have prepared for two years to secure Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain in New Jersey.

item.title: Photographer's images of Messi bathing Yamal as baby resurface before World Cup final
item.description: Photos taken in 2007 showing a teenage Lionel Messi bathing baby Lamine Yamal have become the most talked about images before Sunday's World Cup final.

item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee, last month, qualifying the team for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.
